title: 第十七章 吸光灵性第十八章 血气冲体
content_zh:
“叶枫，之前是我们看扁你了，没想到你还有采药的天赋，嗯，张掌柜说的没错，你确实不是废物。”
“既然如此，本执事可不能浪费了你这天赋，这样吧，从明天起，你就是赵家庄采药队的一员，每天只需上缴一株黄阶中品等级的灵药给庄子，你和你妹妹花菱，就可以安安稳稳在庄子中生活下去。”
赵天乐眯起眼睛笑呵呵说道。
“什么？”
花菱怒极。
每天上缴一株中品灵药？
你怎么不去死？
虽然哥哥这次采摘到了许多药材，但采药这种事靠的是运气，别说中品灵药，就是下品灵药有时候也未必能一天采到一株，况且这么一来，必须每天都进入大黑林。
迟早出事！
这家伙真是吃人不吐骨头。
“赵执事，你说笑了，灵药总有耗尽的一天，外围出现的中品灵药本就不多，别说每天一株，十天一株恐怕也做不到。”
叶枫慢慢说着，说话之间，眼光却看向了长桌上那几个装了药材的大簸箕。
这里汇聚了这么多药材，散发的灵性早让万古长青脉蠢蠢欲动，叶枫一直忍耐着，只是不方便在大庭广众下做出怪诞举动。
现在赵天乐没事找事，倒让叶枫找到了机会。
“不过呢，我叶枫也不能无视赵执事的好意，这样吧，容我考虑考虑……”
“你最好答应！”
赵天乐脸色一沉，威胁道，“赵家庄可不养闲人！”
听到这话的叶枫神情变得非常难看，身子僵在那里不动了。
围观的人都以为叶枫是让赵执事给吓到了。
废物终究是废物，稍微一吓就被吓得六神无主，哼……

“那好吧。
赵执事，不过我接触药材的时间太短，很多灵药都不认识，能不能给我点时间，让我仔细观察观察那些药材。”
良久之后，叶枫才是无奈的点点头，伸手指了指长桌上的大簸箕。
“去吧！”
赵天乐心里那个乐就别提了。
可表面上他却装出一副无所谓的样子，很大度的挥挥手。
“哥哥，你怎么能答应这样的条件？”
花菱有些急促的低声说道，她伸手去拉叶枫，叶枫却回头给了她一个眼神。
“信不信哥哥？”
“我信，可是……”
花菱依旧想说点什么。
“信就可以了，来，陪哥哥看看那些灵药，下次我就认识了。”
叶枫微笑着领着她走过去，从大簸箕中直接抓起了最显眼的那条百年老山参……
……
一株又一株。
很快，叶枫就将大簸箕装着的灵药摸了个遍，在赵天乐等人眼中，他只不过随手摸了摸，然后又放了回去。
content_en:
"Ye Feng, we looked down on you before. I didn't expect you to have the talent of picking herbs. Well, shopkeeper Zhang is right. You are indeed not a waste."
"In this case, I can't waste your talent. Let's do this. From tomorrow on, you will be a member of the Zhaojiazhuang herb collection team. You only need to turn in one yellow-level middle-grade elixir to Zhuangzi every day. You and your sister Hualing can live peacefully in Zhuangzi."
Zhao Tianle narrowed his eyes and said with a smile.
"What?"
Hua Ling was furious.
Turn in a medium-grade elixir every day?
Why don't you die?
Although my brother picked a lot of medicinal materials this time, picking medicines depends on luck. Not to mention middle-grade elixirs, even low-grade elixirs sometimes may not be able to collect one plant in a day. Moreover, in this way, you must enter the Great Black Forest every day.
Sooner or later something will happen!
This guy really eats people without spitting out their bones.
"Deacon Zhao, you are joking. The elixir will eventually run out. There are not many middle-grade elixirs appearing in the periphery. Let alone one plant every day, I am afraid that one plant every ten days will not be enough."
Ye Feng spoke slowly. As he spoke, his eyes looked at the large dustpans filled with medicinal materials on the long table.
There are so many medicinal materials gathered here, and the spirituality emanating from them has already made the evergreen veins ready to move. Ye Feng has been enduring it, but it is not convenient for him to do weird things in public.
Now that Zhao Tianle had nothing to do, Ye Feng found an opportunity.
"However, I, Ye Feng, cannot ignore Deacon Zhao's kindness. Let me think about it..."
"You'd better say yes!"
Zhao Tianle's face darkened and he threatened, "Zhaojiazhuang does not raise idle people!"
After hearing this, Ye Feng's expression became very ugly, and his body froze motionless.
The onlookers thought that Ye Feng had frightened Deacon Zhao.
Waste is waste after all, and if you are even slightly frightened, you will be frightened into confusion, hum...
"Okay then.
Deacon Zhao, but my exposure to medicinal materials is too short, and I don’t know many elixirs. Can you give me some time to observe those medicinal materials carefully? "
After a long time, Ye Feng nodded helplessly and pointed at the big dustpan on the long table.
"Go!"
Not to mention the joy in Zhao Tianle's heart.
But on the surface, he pretended to be indifferent and waved his hand generously.
"Brother, how can you agree to such a condition?"
Hua Ling whispered in a hurry. She reached out to pull Ye Feng, but Ye Feng turned back and gave her a look.
"Do you believe it, brother?"
"I believe it, but..."
Hanabishi still wanted to say something.
"Just a letter is enough. Come, accompany your brother to see those elixirs. I will know them next time."
Ye Feng led her over with a smile and grabbed the most conspicuous century-old ginseng from the big dustpan...
…
One after another.
Soon, Ye Feng touched all the elixir contained in the big dustpan. In the eyes of Zhao Tianle and others, he just touched it casually and then put it back.
